summary: Frontend-only retest of LordTraining i18n in Data → Information sub-sections (Entities/Teams/Federation) using querystring ?lng=en / ?lng=fr to force language. Login as super admin works on /auth (data-testid login-email-input + login-password-input + login-submit-btn). After login + navigating to /dashboard?lng=en the language badge becomes 'EN' (localStorage train_language=en) and ALL the requested labels render in English: top nav (Dashboard/Data/Scouting/Report/Sessions/Alerts/Demo/Admin/Plan/Log out), Data subtabs (Diagnosis/Information/Evaluation/Competitions/Periodization/Graphic Plan/Tools/Previous Plan/Active Plan), Information sub-tabs (Entities/Federation/Teams/Athletes/Sports/Tournaments/Coaches). Entities subsection: 'Entities', 'Federations, clubs, schools, and sports organizations', 'Entity Management', 'Organize federations, clubs, schools, and more in your sports structure', 'New Entity', plus all 6 category cards 'Federation / National Team / League / Tournament / Sports Club / Sports School / Team / Group'. Teams subsection: 'Team Management', 'Create teams, assign sports and entities, and manage their athletes', 'New Team', 'Athletes'. Federation subsection: 'Federation Panel', 'Multi-club · multi-coach · multi-athlete coordination', 'Refresh', 'Federation Report', stat cards (CLUBS/SCHOOLS/TEAM/ATHLETES/COACHES/ACTIVE PLANS/COMPETITIONS/EVALUATIONS 30D), 'HIERARCHY TREE', 'COMPLIANCE COMPARISON BY CLUB', 'No direct child clubs/schools.', 'ASSIGNED STAFF (0)', 'Assign', 'No staff assigned.', 'PLANS (0)', 'No plans registered.', 'COMPETITIONS (0)', 'No linked competitions.' — every previously-Spanish string is now English. With ?lng=fr the pageTranslator goes even further: brand 'SeigneurEntraînement', nav (Tableau/Données/Scouting/Rapport/Séances/Alertes/Démo/Admin/Plan/Déconnexion/FR), 'Panneau de Contrôle', 'Score de Préparation', 'Ratio Charge Aiguë:Chronique', 'PLAN ACTIF / Aucun plan / Cliquer pour sélectionner', 'MES PLANS / ATHLÈTES / ÉVÉNEMENTS / SÉANCES / EXERCICES / ADHÉRENCE', plan list items ('Plan général de sport - ATR (Issurin)', 'Ondulée avancée (Zourdos)', etc.), and the Information subtab label 'Information' + Data view 'Plan d'entraînement / Nouveau plan / Sélectionnez un plan / Choisissez un plan d'entraînement…'. The fix from iter 79 is therefore confirmed working in EN and FR for the in-scope subsections.

issues: The blue page-header strip still reads 'Entities / Federations, clubs, schools, and sports organizations' even after switching to the Teams sub-tab. The body content correctly shows 'Team Management / Create teams, assign sports and entities, and manage their athletes / New Team', so the i18n itself is fine — this is a STATE BUG where the page header doesn't update when you change Information sub-tab (it stays pinned to whichever sub-tab loaded first). Not a translation issue, but cosmetically misleading.

design_issues.screen: Previous Plan view (Diagnosis sub-tab, default landing after selecting a plan)
issues: NOT in the original test scope (Entities/Teams/Federation) but observed during the run: several Spanish literals leak in BOTH EN and FR — '% GLOBAL DE CUMPLIMIENTO', '○ ACEPTABLE', table headers 'INDICADOR / INICIAL / FINAL / DELTA%', placeholder 'No hubo lesiones', section title 'Conclusiones y Recomendaciones', label 'CONCLUSIONES PRINCIPALES', 'MOTOR IA', 'MODELOS A COMPARAR (6/6)', the entire periodization-models picker list (Cibernético / Conjugado / Contraste Francés / Integración Vertical / LordTraining PDI · Periodización Dual Integrada / Péndulo / Secuencial / Trifásico / iTrain PDI / ATD (Navarro) / Bloques Concentrados / Tradicional / Contemporánea Fútbol / Intra-sesión / Potencia para Equipos / Preparación Integrada / Cargas Selectivas / Concurrente / Lineal Inversa / Metabólico-Energético / Periodización Táctica / Polarizado / Alta Frecuencia Noruego / Cluster Sets / Mixta Ondulada / RIR/RPE / No Lineal Flexible / Ondulada Avanzada / Ondulatorio Diario / Ondulatorio Semanal), button 'REGENERAR', and 'RESUMEN EJECUTIVO' paragraph. These appear hardcoded / not wrapped in tt() and the pageTranslator did not pick them up in the wait window — possibly because they are nested in deeply re-rendered IA-model blocks.

action_items: Nothing blocking for the requested scope — Entities/Teams/Federation translations work end-to-end in EN and FR via ?lng=en / ?lng=fr.

(Out of scope, optional) Fix the Teams view page-header still showing 'Entities / Federations, clubs, schools, and sports organizations' — make the header reactive to the selected Information sub-tab.

(Out of scope, optional) Translate the Previous Plan Analysis screen Spanish leftovers (% GLOBAL DE CUMPLIMIENTO, ACEPTABLE, INDICADOR table headers, No hubo lesiones, Conclusiones y Recomendaciones, MOTOR IA, MODELOS A COMPARAR, the 30+ periodization-model picker labels, REGENERAR, RESUMEN EJECUTIVO). User did not ask for this in iter 80 but it will be noticed in EN/FR mode.
critical_code_review_comments: The ?lng= querystring approach (i18n.js detection.order ['querystring','localStorage','navigator','htmlTag']) is reliable and survives login redirect (token in localStorage preserves auth). Recommended over the language-selector UI which iter 79 found unreliable in automation.

pageTranslator.js global DOM translator is clearly active in FR: it translated the brand 'LordTraining→SeigneurEntraînement', stored plan-name strings ('General Sport Plan → Plan général de sport'), and dynamic empty-state strings. Round-trip caching is fast (<6s) on cached entries.

Previous Plan view contains many Spanish strings that are NOT wrapped in i18next AND apparently not in the page-translator allowlist (e.g. the periodization-models picker emojis+names). If the same fix-everywhere expectation applies, the team should run a sweep of Spanish literals in DiagnosisPanel.js / GapAnalysisPanel.js / PreviousPlanPanel.js.
Teams view page-header pinning to 'Entities' looks like a stale-state defect in the parent Information panel; trivial fix but cosmetically confusing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for in-scope (Entities/Teams/Federation translations in EN and FR all rendered correctly)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /auth (NOT /login). Use querystring ?lng=en or ?lng=fr on /dashboard to force language (selector UI is unreliable in automation). After login navigate to /dashboard?lng=en — the token persists from localStorage so the lng param is honoured. To reach Information sub-section: click 'Data' in top nav → click any plan in the left sidebar (otherwise Information sub-tabs are hidden) → click 'Information' (EN) / 'Information' (FR, singular too) → then click Entities/Federation/Teams. Wait 6-8s after each sub-tab render for the global pageTranslator round-trips. Plan list names are themselves auto-translated, so in FR the text=/General Sport Plan/ locator no longer matches — use text=/Plan général de sport/ instead.
rca_of_the_issue: Iter 79 root cause was that the language-selector UI did not actually call i18n.changeLanguage. The implemented fix uses i18next-browser-languagedetector with detection.order=['querystring','localStorage','navigator','htmlTag'] and lookupQuerystring='lng'. Confirmed reproducible: visiting /dashboard?lng=en after login sets train_language=en and the badge to 'EN', and visiting /dashboard?lng=fr translates the entire DOM via pageTranslator.js. All requested labels (Entity Management, New Entity, Team Management, New Team, Federation Panel, Hierarchical Tree=>'HIERARCHY TREE', Compliance comparison by club=>'COMPLIANCE COMPARISON BY CLUB', and the 8 stat cards) render in the target language.
